items.quote: Looking for a YouTube video editor 🎬 Not “I can cut Reels in CapCut” editor. A real long-form YouTube editor who understands: pacing retention storytelling sound design clean structure
items.statement: The post is looking for a long-form YouTube editor who understands pacing, retention, storytelling, sound design, and clean structure.

items.quote: There will be a short test task: editing a 2-minute intro. Portfolio is required.
items.statement: Applicants must fulfill a short test task and provide a portfolio.

items.quote: Remote role. 4 videos per month. Up to 20 minutes each. Adobe Premiere Pro only.
items.statement: The role involves editing 4 videos per month, each up to 20 minutes long, using Adobe Premiere Pro.

items.quote: Remote role. 4 videos per month. Up to 20 minutes each. Adobe Premiere Pro only. Long-form YouTube experience only.
items.statement: The position is a remote role for a long-form YouTube video editor.

overview: An Instagram post seeking a qualified long-form YouTube video editor for remote work.
